annual_compliance: CLG: NAR1 annual return within 42 days of AGM; audited accounts laid before members (Cap.622 Part 9); public-entity fee HK$105, late fees from HK$3,480; s.429 fine up to HK$300,000 and strike-off risk for non-filing.

Private foundations (Law 16/2021): no routine financial-statement filing with the DSF and no published general annual-return requirement; minimal ongoing obligations beyond internal governance and registry updates.

Annual return to Registrar of Charities/ROC each year; accounts examined by independent examiner at <=S$250k income, audit/examination per Charities Act s.14 above; entries on public register; non-filing risks deregistration.

Societies (Act 832, ROS/JPPM): annual return and information to the Registrar (commonly by 1 June); accounts audited as approved by the Registrar; CLGs file with SSM; persistent non-filing risks a provisional dissolution order.

Yayasan (UU 16/2001 as amended by UU 28/2004): annual report to the Ministry of Law; no published audit tier; foundation reports made available internally; sustained non-compliance risks suspension or revocation of the foundation deed.

Charitable juristic persons (C&CC ss.110-136, Dept of Provincial Administration/MoI): annual report and audited financial statements to the Registrar; foreign funding triggers AML Act reporting; non-compliance risks sanctions.

Foreign NGOs operate under Decree 58/2022/ND-CP; annual activity and financial reports to the competent authority (no fixed public deadline); accounts subject to audit; the operating license is revoked for non-compliance.

SEC non-stock/non-profit: general information statement within 30 days after annual meeting via eFAST; audited financial statements due in 4th/5th month post year-end; delay penalty suspended (SEC MC 16/2024); repeated non-filing risks cancellation.

Associations under the 2015 Law (Royal Kram NS/RKM/0815/010), registered with the Ministry of Interior; foreign NGOs under MoU with a line ministry file annual activity/financial reports with MoI; non-compliance risks registration action.

Domestic associations under PMO Decree 115/2009: annual work plans, budgets and activity reports approved by the line ministry; no public audit tier; non-compliance risks suspension of the registration certificate.

Societies registered with the National Registration Bureau: under s.15 of the Societies Act, furnish information and audit accounts as approved by the Registrar annually; the Registrar may issue a provisional dissolution order for non-compliance.

Societies (Cap. 66, Registrar of Societies): no published annual-return form; AGM and constitutional filings apply; minimal public reporting for a small charity; persistent non-compliance risks deregistration.

Non-profit corporate bodies under Decree-Law 5/2005 (3 August 2005): no published routine annual-reporting obligation; minimal duties beyond registry upkeep; consequences of non-filing are not publicly specified.

ACNC: annual information statement within 6 months of financial year end; financial report with review/audit at >=AUD 500k revenue and audit at >=AUD 3m; failure to lodge for two consecutive years leads to deregistration.

Incorporated Societies Act 2022: file annual financial statements and an annual return with Companies Office within 6 months of year end (exempt if registered with Charities Services); non-filing risks strike-off/dissolution.

Annual return and financial statements to the Registrar of Companies (Companies Act 2015, Part 32 financial reporting); charitable companies must keep full records; persistent non-filing exposes the company to strike-off.

Annual return each calendar year to IPA (Companies Act 1997, s.215); IPA has issued strike-off notices to non-filers; associations under the 2023 Act file their own annual returns; no published audit tier for charities.
Annual return (Form 12) to the Companies Registry each year; no obligation to file financial statements for a small charitable CLG; persistent non-filing risks strike-off/dissolution of the company.

Charitable trusts under the 1993 Act, registered with the Business Registry (MCCTIL); no published routine annual-reporting obligation; minimal registry filings; 2026 consultation proposes strengthening trustee disclosure.

Annual return (Form 14, Companies Act 2012 s.119) to VFSC each year; late fees apply; persistent non-filing leads to strike-off with restoration under s.150; charitable organizations are also registered with VFSC.
